rationale: allocation records inventory actually received rather than expected inventory
allocation cannot exceed an unapproved request
received quantity is the authoritative physical quantity available to allocate
approved quantity is the authoritative replenishment authorization
ordered and requested quantities describe intent rather than received or authorized quantity
physically received inventory remains usable even when the shipment is incomplete
quantity corrections must preserve aggregate integrity or be coordinated with allocation adjustments
status labels do not establish a numeric ceiling
no authoritative allocation source exists and candidate relationships are not operational evidence
